the Atlantic thermohalamie circulation is weakened in all models in response to a quadrupling of atmospheric CO2 concentration, but that the circulation does not collapse, despite the rapidity and high final value of the CO2 concentration increase. [ 2]

the climate response of the Atlantic THC to increasing CO2 is a gradual weakening, but that no model shows a rapid collapse or a cooling. [ 2]

the Atlantic THC will decline gradually as the climate warms, with a large range of possible magnitudes of the reduction, but without a rapid collapse.
